_note: Captured runs, not written by hand: the uv lines from a throwaway UV_TOOL_DIR install, the doctor lines from the same run transcripts/doctor.json was cut from, the create-app lines from transcripts/first-app.json, the configure and build lines from transcripts/configure-and-build.json. Two abridgements, both so a stage fits the walkthrough frame without clipping: the per-step ninja lines are replaced by the collapsed muted line, and the size line keeps its columns but drops the leading build/apollo510_evb/ from the filename. The device lines after nsx flash and nsx view are placeholders and say so: NSX prints device output only with a board attached, and nothing may stand in for a capture we do not have (AmbiqAI/neuralspotx#260).

stages.title: Install the CLI
stages.caption: One tool on your path. uv is already a host requirement, so there is nothing else to set up.

stages.title: Check the environment

stages.label: Create
stages.title: Create an app for a board
stages.caption: A complete app directory for a real board: nsx.yml, CMakeLists.txt, sources and the starter modules.

stages.label: Build
stages.title: Configure and build
stages.caption: Modules resolve and lock, CMake generates, Ninja builds. The result is an ordinary project you own.
